title: For the last few months I’ve been working on an adventure rhythm game where you have to battle your way to respect and is a parody of a main strip in Denver, CO
author: ThinkTyler
selftext:
Hii first post here! The Big Gig is made on Godot with Kenney, Quaternius, and Google low poly art assets, Claude code, and me behind all the music and game design. I am making this game for myself and for fun mainly, but thought I’d share here and get some early feedback.  

It’s in a pre-alpha state right now. I have most of the strip built as a first pass only but only the opening tutorial battle and full interior of the first venue, so that’s why it repeats in the video. The idea is that every gatekeeper on the scene (12 total, including two bandmates) you have to battle will have a slightly different mini game mechanic to attack and defend, kinda like Undertale but all timing based. I have all the core mechanics already built and performance ready for scalability. Just need to build all the content and write the rest of the story and dialog now.

What do you think? Would you play this? Any suggestions?

comments.author: drawdrawink
comments.body: I love this. Is that Broadway?

replies.author: ThinkTyler
replies.body: Yup, South Broadway with parody names of every main building!
